chunks: Ja'far ibn Muhammad ibn Masroor (may God be pleased with him) narrated that Al-Hussein ibn Muhammad ibn Aamir quoted on the authority of al-Mo'alla ibn Muhammad al-Basri, on the authority of Al-Hassan ibn Ali al-Washsha',

He said: I asked Abil Hassan Al-Ridha (peace be upon him), 'Will the Earth remain without an Imam?' He said, 'No.' I said, 'We narrate that it will not remain [empty] unless God becomes angry with the servants.' He said, 'It will not remain [empty], otherwise it would sink.'
ai.seo_question: What happens to the Earth if it is left without an Imam according to Shia hadith?
ai.summary: In this tradition from *Uyun Akhbar al-Rida*, Imam Al-Rida (peace be upon him) affirms the doctrine of the *Baqiyat Allah* (the Everlasting Proof of God), asserting that the Earth cannot exist in a state of divine neglect (*Ghayba*). He clarifies that the famous narration regarding the Earth sinking if left without an Imam refers specifically to the consequence of divine displeasure, thereby establishing the Imam as the essential pillar (*Hujjah*) that maintains cosmic order and prevents the world from collapsing into chaos.
